svg.title: heat equation, 3 Jacobi steps
svg.desc:
Numerical experiment with panels: heat equation, 3 Jacobi steps; heat equation, 5 Jacobi steps; heat equation, 10 Jacobi steps; ADE with $
u=0.01$, 2 Jacobi steps; ADE with $
u=0.01$, 3 Jacobi steps; ADE with $
u=0.01$, 4 Jacobi steps
